assessments.reasoning: The annotation-scope section explicitly identifies type alias values as annotation-scope code and permits class namespace lookup when this scope is directly enclosed by a class. The same paragraph distinguishes regular functions in classes.

challenge.method: Read the list of constructs and the class-scope rule, then evaluated a class type alias that referred to an ordinary class attribute and a regular method that tried to resolve the same bare name.
challenge.results: The alias evaluated to the class attribute and the regular method raised NameError. The documented visibility rule corresponds to the alias's immediate annotation-scope placement.

limitations: This covers code in an annotation scope immediately enclosed by a class. It makes no general claim about all forms of annotations or ordinary methods.
